dedupe_keys.name: programme to generate statistically based occupancy and occupant driven electrical demand profiles

description: Programme to generate statistically-based occupancy and occupant driven electrical demand profiles. is a model or code deposit deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors Graeme Hamilton Flett. This tool can be used to generate single or multiple occupancy and related occupancy-driven electrical demand and hot water demand profiles. The data output can be deployed in activities such as building performance simulation, stock modelling, district heating analysis, energy flexibility analysis and smart grid analysis. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 69MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
